test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Napoleon went to great lenths to craft his image as a benign ruler.
Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a benign ruler.
Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a benign rouler.
Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a benine ruler.

solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"lengths"** means the extent of something from end to end; it can also refer to the amount of effort put into achieving something. (लंबाई, प्रयास की मात्रा) • **Example: **She went to great **lengths** to ensure that the event was successful. • **"Benign" **refers to something that is gentle, kind, and not harmful. (दयालु, हानिरहित) • **Example: **The doctor assured us that the tumor was** benign** and not life-threatening. Therefore, the correct sentence having correct spellings is **"Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a benign ruler." ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** Napoleon went to great lenths to craft his image as a benign ruler. (लंबाई की स्पेलिंग गलत है) • **Example:** The word** "lengths"** is misspelled as **"lenths".** • **Option 3:** Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a benign** rouler**. (रूलर की स्पेलिंग गलत है) • **Example:** The word **"ruler"** is misspelled as "rouler". • **Option 4:** Napoleon went to great lengths to craft his image as a **benine** ruler. (बेनाइन की स्पेलिंग गलत है) • **Example:** The word** "benign" **is misspelled as **"benine."** 38:Tdfb, The correct answer is** Option 3)**
